records.trigger: Use of the ten recorded qualitative design-intent statements in the fictional flagship laboratory.
records.conclusion: This is the direct project basis for the accepted qualitative synthetic requirements; each remains inactive and non-executable.
records.uncertainty: No numerical parameters, detailed sequence, evaluation rule, physical authorization, or legal applicability follows from this basis.
records.future_verification: Obtain project-owner approval for any future parameter, mapping, activation, or executable rule and the applicable qualified technical review.

records.trigger: Execution of a future fictional scenario using the versioned flagship profile.
records.conclusion: The listed quantities, exclusions, and qualitative pressure direction bound simulation content only.
records.uncertainty: The assumptions have not been domain-validated and do not resolve regulatory thresholds or physical design.
records.future_verification: Review the complete fictional material, process, equipment, and operating profile with the relevant disciplines before representing it as typical practice.

records.trigger: Regulated new construction or occupancy in New York outside New York City after the recorded effective date.
records.conclusion: The 2025 New York Uniform Code is the adopted jurisdictional reference set for the fictional profile, but section-level applicability is not determined.
records.uncertainty: A fictional profile cannot establish permit date, site facts, amendments, variances, enforcement actions, or legal applicability.
records.future_verification: Confirm the exact project-effective code set, permit facts, local amendments, and enforcement status with the actual authority for any real project.

records.trigger: A parcel within Town enforcement territory and outside incorporated villages.
records.conclusion: Town sources support the project-owner assumption that the Town code-enforcement authority is the fictional local AHJ reference.
records.uncertainty: The project has no real parcel, and agreements, opt-out status, local-law currency, amendments, and permit responsibility remain unverified.
records.future_verification: Verify parcel jurisdiction, the current Town program, State records, intermunicipal agreements, local amendments, and permit responsibilities.

records.trigger: Classification of the fictional new research laboratory after its full use and hazard facts are declared.
records.conclusion: Group B is a plausible fictional assumption for the stated testing and research use; FacilityOps does not determine the legal occupancy classification.
records.uncertainty: Hazards, quantities, control areas, fire areas, incidental uses, and complete building configuration remain unresolved.
records.future_verification: Complete a qualified occupancy and hazardous-material classification review using official or licensed code text and the final fictional profile.

records.trigger: A process satisfying the adopted contaminant-exhaust or hazardous-exhaust conditions.
records.conclusion: The source is technically relevant to the exhaust and makeup-air profile, but it does not directly require the project-selected fan pair, treatment dependency, pressure direction, or sequence on the current facts.
records.uncertainty: The hazardous-exhaust trigger, fire-area facts, material ratings, airborne concentration, and use of any laboratory-manifold provision are not established.
records.future_verification: Review exact licensed code provisions against the final SDS, process, quantities, air path, fire-area, and AHJ determinations.

records.trigger: A material category, quantity, use, storage, process, or permit condition within the adopted Fire Code.
records.conclusion: The source governs the future classification process, but the simulation quantities do not establish a threshold or permit conclusion.
records.uncertainty: The exact SDS, composition, hazard categories, aggregate quantities, control areas, and AHJ interpretation are absent.
records.future_verification: Obtain the product SDS and complete a qualified material, quantity, use, storage, control-area, and permit review.

records.trigger: A private-sector employer with covered employees performing the fictional activities in New York.
records.conclusion: Federal OSHA is the appropriate regulator reference for the fictional private-sector profile, subject to actual employer and worker facts.
records.uncertainty: No actual employer, employee, exposure, or covered work activity exists in the repository.
records.future_verification: For any real use, verify the employer, employment relationship, work activity, and the current federal and State enforcement allocation.

records.trigger: Covered laboratory use of a hazardous chemical with potential employee exposure.
records.conclusion: The research, small-scale, and nonproduction facts make this a plausible future regulatory source, but applicability is not established.
records.uncertainty: Product hazard classification, exposure potential, procedure facts, protective practices, and the Chemical Hygiene Plan are missing.
records.future_verification: Obtain the supplier SDS, complete hazard and exposure review, and evaluate the regulatory definitions and exclusions with a qualified employer representative.

records.trigger: Covered employee exposure to the exact listed alumina substance or another regulated particulate.
records.conclusion: The source confirms a potentially relevant occupational exposure basis, not a FacilityOps sequence or airflow criterion.
records.uncertainty: Alumina-based does not establish alpha-alumina identity, composition, particle fraction, crystalline-silica content, or exposure.
records.future_verification: Obtain SDS and CAS data, characterize physical form and constituents, and perform a qualified exposure assessment before using any regulatory limit.

records.trigger: A known workplace chemical for which covered employees may be exposed.
records.conclusion: A supplier SDS and product identity are necessary future controlled artifacts for hazard and applicability research.
records.uncertainty: The fictional product and its regulatory classification do not yet exist.
records.future_verification: Select a fictional sanitized product profile with source-controlled SDS metadata and complete the hazard-classification review.

records.trigger: Project selection of laboratory-ventilation practice after licensed and domain review.
records.conclusion: This is a strong technical-scope match and an informative influence on evidence and review categories, not a direct source of the synthetic sequence.
records.uncertainty: Full text is paid, and adoption, contractual selection, applicability, and exact requirements are not established.
records.future_verification: Obtain licensed text and qualified laboratory-ventilation review before adopting any detailed requirement or parameter.

records.trigger: Project selection of local-exhaust practice after licensed and domain review.
records.conclusion: This is an informative local-exhaust system influence; it does not directly mandate the project's treatment, fan pair, pressure direction, or sequence.
records.uncertainty: Full text is paid, and source overlap, adoption, project selection, and exact applicability are unresolved.
records.future_verification: Obtain licensed text and qualified local-exhaust and industrial-hygiene review before selecting criteria or requirements.

records.trigger: An exhaust system and material within the standard's fire or explosion protection scope.
records.conclusion: Particulate exhaust makes the title relevant for scope review, but the noncombustible profile and combustible-dust exclusion prevent a scope assumption.
records.uncertainty: Full-text review and exact material/process facts are needed; no adoption or project selection is established.
records.future_verification: Review licensed scope text and the final SDS, dust characterization, and process configuration with fire-protection and industrial-hygiene disciplines.

records.trigger: Electrical installation of the VFDs, motors, controls, and instrumentation under an adopted edition.
records.conclusion: Electrical installation has a controlled code basis, but installation conformance and operational evidence are separate questions.
records.uncertainty: The publisher-current edition differs from the New York adopted edition, and no actual installation design exists.
records.future_verification: Pin the New York incorporated edition, exact installation scope, design documents, equipment instructions, inspection evidence, and qualified electrical review.

records.trigger: Interpretation of rated fan capability versus installed system response.
records.conclusion: Fan rating and system-effect concepts support keeping request, speed, electrical response, and delivered airflow as distinct evidence categories.
records.uncertainty: No fan selection, certified rating, system curve, or installed test exists, and the source does not define FacilityOps evidence independence.
records.future_verification: Select actual fictional fan and system data, identify applicable AMCA references, and obtain qualified fan-system review before selecting criteria.

records.trigger: Future measured airflow, differential pressure, or electrical power evidence.
records.conclusion: Measurement standards can inform evidence metadata and method selection but do not supply scenario criteria.
records.uncertainty: Methods, instruments, locations, calibration, uncertainty, tolerances, persistence, and review have not been selected.
records.future_verification: Obtain exact source text and define the measurement plan, instruments, calibration, setup, uncertainty, and qualified review for each evidence category.

records.trigger: Future use of field airflow, pressure, or balancing evidence.
records.conclusion: Field measurement and reporting concepts can inform later evidence records; a test report is not an authorization or acceptance record.
records.uncertainty: No field system, instrument, procedure, test authority, or selected standard exists.
records.future_verification: Define the exact test scope, procedure, instrument, uncertainty, operating mode, authority, and disposition boundary before use.

records.trigger: Use of commissioning-process concepts for future requirements, verification, issues, records, and disposition separation.
records.conclusion: The source informs process architecture only and reinforces separation between computation, verification records, and human acceptance.
records.uncertainty: No contractual selection or commissioning project exists; FacilityOps replay cannot create commissioning acceptance.
records.future_verification: If used later, identify the selected project-effective commissioning sources, roles, records, authority, and approved fictional scope.

records.trigger: Study of structured sequence representation and testable control intent.
records.conclusion: The guideline is a design specimen for explicit modes, transitions, faults, points, and tests, not a source for the flagship exhaust sequence.
records.uncertainty: No Guideline 36 sequence has been selected, and continuous-maintenance addenda require version control.
records.future_verification: Pin the exact edition and addenda only if a later approved bounded comparison uses its concepts.

records.trigger: A later approved comparison of one bounded controller sequence representation.
records.conclusion: CDL concepts may inform explicit inputs, outputs, parameters, blocks, and exchange, but this package uses a FacilityOps-native requirement representation.
records.uncertainty: No CDL model or engine is implemented, and modeled logic cannot establish field or physical response.
records.future_verification: If approved later, pin Standard 231 resources and implementation versions and compare only one bounded sequence.

records.trigger: Design of later reproducible replay, mapping, unit, parameter, and comparison records.
records.conclusion: OpenBuildingControl supplies useful reproducibility concepts and an explicit boundary between controller-program verification and physical validation.
records.uncertainty: It is evolving research, not a legal or contractual requirement, and its tolerances or scripts are not FacilityOps criteria.
records.future_verification: Pin an exact specification/report version before reusing any representation or comparison behavior in an approved later slice.

records.trigger: Future publication and review of bounded controller-program conformance scripts.
records.conclusion: The proposed scope is informative for a future comparison boundary only; it has no current normative or implementation role.
records.uncertainty: No published standard or final scripts exist, and bench controller-program testing excludes physical sensors and devices.
records.future_verification: Monitor publication status and review exact final text before any future project dependency or comparison.
